title: Machine learning methods revealed the roles of immune-metabolism related genes in immune infiltration, stemness, and prognosis of neuroblastoma.
authors: Mu, Jianhua; Gong, Jianan; Lin, Peng; Zhang, Mengzhen; Wu, Kai
journal: Cancer biomarkers : section A of Disease markers
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习构建神经母细胞瘤免疫代谢相关基因的预后模型，聚焦肿瘤预后与免疫浸润，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Immunometabolism plays an important role in neuroblastoma (NB). However, the mechanism of immune-metabolism related genes (IMRGs) in NB remains unclear. This study aimed to explore the effects of IMRGs on the prognosis, immune infiltration and stemness of patients with NB using machine learning methods. METHODS: R software (v4.2.1) was used to identify the differentially expressed IMRGs, and machine learning algorithm was used to screen the prognostic genes from IMRGs. Then we constructed a prognostic model and calculated the risk scores. The NB patients were grouped according to the prognosis scores. In addition, the genes most associated with the immune infiltration and stemness of NB were analyzed by weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA). RESULTS: There were 89 differentially expressed IMRGs between the MYCN amplification and the MYCN non-amplification group, among which CNR1, GNAI1, GLDC and ABCC4 were selected by machine learning algorithm to construct the prognosis model due to their better prediction effect. Both the K-M survival curve and the 5-year Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve indicated that the prognosis model could predict the prognosis of NB patients, and there was significant difference in immune infiltration between the two groups according to the median of risk score. CONCLUSIONS: We verified the effects of IMRGs on the prognosis, immune infiltration and stemness of NB. These findings could provide help for predicting prognosis and developing immunotherapy in NB.
abstract_zh: 背景：免疫代谢在神经母细胞瘤（NB）中发挥重要作用。然而，免疫代谢相关基因（IMRGs）在NB中的机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在利用机器学习方法探讨IMRGs对NB患者预后、免疫浸润和干性的影响。方法：使用R软件（v4.2.1）鉴定差异表达的IMRGs，并采用机器学习算法从IMRGs中筛选预后基因。随后构建预后模型并计算风险评分。根据预后评分对NB患者进行分组。此外，通过加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）分析与NB免疫浸润和干性最相关的基因。结果：在MYCN扩增组和MYCN非扩增组之间共有89个差异表达的IMRGs，其中CNR1、GNAI1、GLDC和ABCC4因预测效果较好而被机器学习算法选中以构建预后模型。K-M生存曲线和5年受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线均表明该预后模型能预测NB患者的预后，且根据风险评分中位数分组的两组间免疫浸润存在显著差异。结论：我们验证了IMRGs对NB预后、免疫浸润和干性的影响。这些发现可为NB的预后预测和免疫治疗开发提供帮助。
